x: Forward running by Saunders, Taylor and Shields, the three very useful soldier brothers, R., E. and D. Patience, Art Allum and Jack Flower were also in good trim, and lastly had they not dug dear old Syd Warboys from his armchair?
Two members of other clubs came by, then Jack Flower. Another seven seconds elapse, one stranger passes, and R.
ALLUM 1, HARRY SHIELDS 4, JACK FLOWER 6, RON PATIENCE 8, ALF TAYLOR 11, DAN PATIENCE 15. Two team wins, two individual wins, the same afternoon---what running!
